\[ 1995 = 3 \times 5 \times 7 \times 19 \]

The number of divisors of \( 1995^2 \) is calculated by adding 1 to each of the exponents in the prime factorization and multiplying the results:
\[ (2+1)(2+1)(2+1)(2+1) = 3^4 = 81 \]

\[ \frac{81 + 1}{2} = 41 \]
